rationale: Price is at 96.7% of today's range and within 0.37% of the session high after a strong intraday recovery from $10.00 to $11.21, leaving very little upside buffer before resistance while the risk/reward for a long is unfavorable at this extended position. A short against the prevailing momentum with 87 minutes remaining and price still grinding higher on the last five candles carries equal risk of continuation. With SPY negative and VIXY elevated, the macro backdrop adds uncertainty, and the mechanical setup does not offer a clean entry in either direction with a favorable invalidation-to-target ratio.
